name: typoscript-highlighting
description: TypoScript and TSconfig highlighting, TYPO3 site sets, typed settings, import navigation and configurable colors for VS Code and VSCodium.

typoscriptHighlighting.typo3Version.markdownDescription: Optional target-version override for standalone extensions or incomplete projects. Leave **Auto** to detect Composer and Classic installations from the active core, installed package metadata or Composer files. The status bar explains the source and any version mismatch.
enumDescriptions: Detect the project automatically; no version setting is needed for complete installations.
Use modern comment rules (TYPO3 12 and later).
Use modern comment rules for TYPO3 13.
Use modern comment rules for TYPO3 14.

typoscriptHighlighting.commentRules.deprecationMessage: Use Typo3 Version instead. Existing Comment Rules settings are still honored when the new setting is not explicitly configured.

typoscriptHighlighting.colors.comments.markdownDescription: Comments and comment delimiters. Enter a `#RRGGBB` color or leave empty for **System Default** (the active theme). [Open color picker](command:typoscriptHighlighting.configureColors?%5B%22comments%22%5D) to choose from a spectrum. Changes apply immediately. Use **Inherit** in the picker to remove an override; clearing the field explicitly selects the editor theme.
typoscriptHighlighting.colors.comments.patternErrorMessage: Use #RRGGBB, or leave empty for System Default.

typoscriptHighlighting.diagnostics.enabl.markdownDescription: Report structural errors, unresolved imports, version-specific migration hints and site-set YAML dependency/type errors. Constants, conditions and runtime overrides are not evaluated.

typoscriptHighlighting.formatting.enable.markdownDescription: Enable conservative indentation formatting for structurally complete documents. Literal values and multiline value content are preserved. Uses the editor’s tab size and insert-spaces settings.
